description: Create (no id) or update (with id) a Brevo email template (POST /smtp/templates | PUT /smtp/templates/{id}). Create requires templateName, subject, sender ({ name, email } or { id }) and htmlContent or htmlUrl. Optional: id, replyTo, toField, tag, isActive, attachmentUrl.

attachmentUrl.description: URL of a file attached to mails sent with this template

htmlContent.description: HTML body of the template (or use htmlUrl)

htmlUrl.description: URL from which Brevo loads the HTML body

id.description: Brevo template ID to update; omit to create a new template

sender.description: Sender as { name, email } or { id } of a Brevo sender

tag.description: Tag for grouping the template in Brevo

templateName.description: Name of the template (required when creating)

toField.description: Personalised To field of the template

name: upsert_brevo_template
